summary: 10 m kerb outside an apartment block, steep, with a No Stopping sign.

drivers.seclusion: Signature Point apartments sit 3 m away along the whole stretch; houses all round.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow street with cars parked tight against the kerb; stretch is under a van length plus margin.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street near a junction.
drivers.convention: 4P parallel sign and a No Stopping Any Time sign cover this kerb.

sun_shade: Apartment building shades the west side; trees at the north end.
